name: Bohostice (Czechia)
description: Blue field with a yellow stripe in the upper third and a white stripe in the lower third, each half the height of the blue stripes, overlaid by a green triangle from the hoist edge reaching half the flag's length.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 October 2007 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
